sources.title: ACE-Step 1.5: Pushing the Boundaries of Open-Source Music Generation
sources.snippet: 📝 Abstract 🚀 We present ACE-Step v1.5, a highly efficient open-source music foundation model that brings commercial-grade generation to consumer hardware. On commonly used evaluation metrics, ACE-Step v1.5 achieves quality beyond most commercial music models while remaining extremely fast— under 2 seconds per full song on an A100 and under 10 seconds on an RTX 3090.
